prediction.rationale:
Cooler: close to total failure. Evidence: TS4 mean temperature 49.7 °C (60% above healthy); TS1 mean temperature 54.4 °C (51% above healthy); TS3 mean temperature 55.9 °C (44% above healthy). Rapid temperature accumulation with minimal inlet-outlet drop indicates loss of cooling circulation.
Valve: close to total failure. Evidence: PS1/PS2 valve switching lag 10.0 s (2% above healthy); PS2 pressure rise time 9.69 s (4% above healthy). Substantial delay in circuit pressurization confirms delayed spool actuation in the main valve.
Pump leakage: severe leakage. Evidence: FS1 mean volume flow 6.32 l/min (4% below healthy); EPS1/FS1 power-to-flow ratio 381 W·min/l (within 1% of healthy); SE system efficiency factor 56.6 % (3% below healthy). Significant reduction in delivered volume flow at nominal electrical power indicates severe internal pump slippage.
Accumulator: optimal. Evidence: PS2 pressure ripple 46.1 bar (within 1% of healthy). Pressure stability and surge dampening meet full design specifications.
